thread:
Maria B: heads-up: scheduling a regional change in eu-west-1 on 2026-03-22 01:00 UTC. plan is to pin the routing to model variant `rm-infer-v2.3.1-qt` for dedicated pools while we validate canary.
DeployBot: deploy window scheduled: eu-west-1 2026-03-22 01:00 -> 01:30 UTC. canary=5% traffic. run_id=db-20260322-euw
Jasper: quick q — why pin instead of letting v2.4 continue? is this risk-driven or perf-driven?
Maria B: perf-driven. v2.4 is producing a bimodal p95 on long-context workloads; v2.3.1-qt has steady latency and better unit-cost for batch workloads.
Sarah: starting customer comms. drafting statuspage + enterprise email. will need ops + legal review before sending.
Lee: fallback thresholds: if canary error_rate > 2% OR p95 > 450ms for 3 consecutive mins -> pause and revert traffic to `rm-infer-v2.2.9-qt` for eu-west-1. runbook link: https://internal.runbooks.redwood/rollbacks
DeployBot: canary launched at 01:05 UTC. metrics: success=99.6% p95=310ms errors=0.8%.
Jasper: run long-context generation smoke and embeddings validation. ping me on any tokenization or checksum mismatches.
Sarah: draft statuspage text (internal review):
"Scheduled maintenance: eu-west-1 model routing pin (2026-03-22 01:00 UTC). We will temporarily pin inference routing to a verified model variant to maintain performance stability during a regional rollout. Some requests may see brief transient failures while canary validation runs. No configuration changes required."
Need a dedicated-customer note about SLA/impact.
Maria B: add for Dedicated: "Dedicated customers: regional routing will be pinned to a verified model variant for the duration of the window. No customer action required; SLA coverage remains unchanged. Contact your CSM for specifics."
Sarah: adding. enterprise email draft:
Subject: 2026-03-22 eu-west-1 maintenance — routing pin
Body: Hello, we will pin model routing in eu-west-1 to `rm-infer-v2.3.1-qt` at 01:00 UTC to mitigate latency anomalies observed on v2.4. You may observe short transient errors during canary validation. If you run private deployments or have custom routing, reply and your CSM will reach out.
(ops + escalation contacts included)
Lee: include pager and escalation steps in the email: pager: +1-555-OPS, escalation channel: #eng-oncall, postmortem window: 72h if rollback occurs.
Jasper: add API changelog snippet: "No breaking API changes. This is model-variant routing pinning only. Clients wanting absolute repeatability should set model_version in requests."
Statuspage Bot: staging incident created: https://staging.status.redwood.ai/incidents/20260322-euw-pin (internal)
Sarah: legal pinged for enterprise wording (tagging Legal Team). please review privacy line: "No customer data will be exported or accessed during this operation."
Legal Team: quick review — wording ok, suggest removing the word "non-disruptive" and say "minimal disruption expected".
Maria B: noted. change: "minimal disruption expected; short transient failures possible". plan: if canary green at 01:17 -> move to 50% at 01:20 and full by 01:30. will post go/no-go at 01:18 UTC.
DeployBot: canary metrics @01:15 UTC -> success=99.5% p95=335ms errors=0.9% (within thresholds).
Jasper: LGTM. prepare a short release note for docs: region: eu-west-1; action: temporary pin to `rm-infer-v2.3.1-qt`; reason: mitigate p95 bimodality in v2.4; impact: transient failures possible; rollback: auto-fallback to `rm-infer-v2.2.9-qt` if thresholds hit.
Sarah: final customer email queued to send at 01:22 UTC if no holds. will post the copy to #customer-notifications.
Maria B: GO at 01:21 UTC to proceed with stage 2. monitoring closely — react with :rotating_light: to escalate.
DeployBot: progressed to 50% at 01:24 UTC. initiating full rollout at 01:28 UTC.
Statuspage Bot: update published: "Maintenance in progress: pinning model routing in eu-west-1. Monitoring."
Lee: graphs look stable. no alerts.
Sarah: enterprise email sent at 01:29 UTC. copy archived in #customer-notifications.
DeployBot: rollout complete 01:30 UTC. run_id=db-20260322-euw status=SUCCESS. eu-west-1 pinned to `rm-infer-v2.3.1-qt`.
Maria B: thanks team — closing. postmortem checklist: collect canary metrics, customer error logs, and add a short note to release-notes channel tomorrow.
